message: You know those moments when the power goes out, and you suddenly realize you have no candles, no flashlights, and your phone's about to die? I’ve been there, and let me tell you, it can turn into a comedy show pretty quickly! I found a great guide that offers some practical tips on how to prepare for those unexpected blackouts. It's all about being ready so we can laugh instead of scramble when the lights go out. How do you keep the fun alive during a power outage?
